radius-control.$description: Buttons, inputs, chips, checkboxes. One rule: what you press or what labels a state has a 2px corner.

radius-panel.$description: Panels, grid cells, dialogs, sheets: containers are square, so cells join into one modular grid.

radius-media.$description: Photo wells and marketing imagery: square crops, like the containers they sit in.

touch-target.$description: Minimum control size on coarse pointers (manual 6.12).

space-unit.$description: Tailwind's --spacing multiplier. The brand spacing scale is n x 4px, so p-4 = brand spacing 4.
